leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a generic List<T> component that accepts a type parameter for its items.
Initialize and manage state for a list of items using the useState hook.
Construct a handler function to add new items of a specified type to the list.
Render the list items dynamically by mapping over the state array.
Apply type safety by defining and using an interface for the item structure.
Configure the component to display a message when the list is empty.
Integrate user input controls to manipulate the list contents.
